given_when_then.given: A Store Partner Agreement is active
given_when_then.when: The system processes a settlement event for an Order Request
given_when_then.then: The system retrieves and applies the commission rates and payout terms defined in the agreement to the Financial Transaction Record

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with split amounts calculated according to the Store Partner Agreement

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review

success_criteria: The system retrieves commission rates from the active Store Partner Agreement when processing settlement events.
The system distributes payout amounts strictly according to the commission rates and terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
The system ensures the sum of all distributed amounts equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
The system generates a Financial Transaction Record for every completed delivery regardless of outcome.
The system pauses financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual verification when high-risk indicators are detected.
